price_requests_submit_check.name: price_requests_submit_check
price_requests_submit_check.value: "price_requests"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR "price_requests"."status" = 'CANCELLED' OR ("price_requests"."scope_summary" IS NOT NULL AND "price_requests"."billing_engine" IS NOT NULL AND "price_requests"."target_price" IS NOT NULL)

approval_steps_reject_comment_check.name: approval_steps_reject_comment_check
approval_steps_reject_comment_check.value: "approval_steps"."status" NOT IN ('REJECTED','CHANGES_REQUESTED') OR "approval_steps"."comment" IS NOT NULL

contracts_repository_check.name: contracts_repository_check
contracts_repository_check.value: "contracts"."status" NOT IN ('SIGNED','ACTIVE') OR "contracts"."repository_url" IS NOT NULL

change_requests_exception_check.name: change_requests_exception_check
change_requests_exception_check.value: NOT "change_requests"."cm_exception" OR ("change_requests"."exception_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "change_requests"."exception_expires_on" IS NOT NULL)

rfps_delivered_reviewed_chk.name: rfps_delivered_reviewed_chk
rfps_delivered_reviewed_chk.value: "rfps"."delivered_at" IS NULL OR "rfps"."cm_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
